name: Quari

sections.text:
X 4000 230 12 -96 10000 0 15000
Quari ( Med )
  This theater consists of blow'em up
missions, which are easy and the
threat on most missions is medium.
Quari is a desert planet with gravity
about 2x Earth normal, and a dense and
voluminous atmosphere.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------ Welcome to Dulles International Airport -------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : Haphazard Hazard
 Direction         : East
 Distance          : 17 miles  
 Difficulty        : 4
Sxyth -156740 -5507194 128219 48328
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  There is an enemy structure to the East of here which looks like the
alien commander was a little overzealous with the forcefields.  Take out
the TRFRU and storage tanks while keeping an eye on your six for 
bothersome KLA's.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------- Welcome to Bubba's Airstrip -----------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : In through the out door
 Direction         : East
 Distance          : 12 miles  
 Difficulty        : 4
Sxyth 3702160 -5426520 173876 49226
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  There is a forcefield canyon visible off to the East.  In the canyon
are multiple portals.  Your mission is to travel through the one which
an alien is standing beneath.  This will take some hot flying, so be
prepared.
------------------------------------------------------------------------







 Mission Code Name : Firefly
 Direction         : North North West
 Distance          : 22 miles  
 Difficulty        : 4
Sxyth 5155644 -4005790 72671 796
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Bomb a well protected orb.  The air is filled with mortar defenses,
so choose your bombing flight path carefully.
------------------------------------------------------------------------






 Mission Code Name : Misplaced Frisbee
 Direction         : Unknown
 Distance          : Unknown
 Difficulty        : 3
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  We made a sighting of an enemy saucer yesterday, and we suspect it may
still be in the area.  If you see it, take it out.
------------------------------------------------------------------------


------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------------ Welcome to the Weedsport Airport --------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Mission Code Name : Hopping Mad
 Direction         : West South West
 Distance          : 12 miles  
 Difficulty        : 2
Sxyth -6300735 1602080 35467 25882
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Take out an orb with an assassin bomb.  The orb is 100% protected by
force fields, so you'll have to land your plane in the sand, and
approach this one by foot.  Note that you will not survive if you jump
from the top step all the way to the ground.  Try planting the bomb
over the orb, and letting it fall into the sphere.
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : Sky Hopping
 Direction         : South East
 Distance          : 8 miles  
 Difficulty        : 3
Sxyth -5344472 -499597 212898 33320
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  How are your jumping muscles feeling?  We're having an outbreak of
mental health problems here at the intelligence center.  It has been
discovered that the source is an alien mindbender unit located at
around 15,000 feet to the Southeast of here.  Lord knows why, but they
have suspended an airstrip up there which we think you can land on.
  Although recon has not identified the exact position of the bender,
it must be up there somewhere.  Get up there, and blow up that bender
with an assassin bomb.
  Warning:  Do not take out the orb before attacking the mindbender, or
you may ruin your chances of ever completing this objective!
------------------------------------------------------------------------






 Mission Code Name : Bed of Nails
 Direction         : North
 Distance          : 8 miles  
 Difficulty        : 4
Sxyth -3684876 36637 99467 0
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Take out two suspended orbs.  They have a curious arrangement of
AAA beneath them, and watch out for some KLA's.  Also make sure you
take out all the AAA sites as a secondary mission.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------- Welcome to RDU ^international Airport ----------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : Cloud A
 Direction         : North East
 Distance          : 8 miles  
 Difficulty        : 3
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  At 14,000 feet, the aliens have placed a generator orb with some
AAA and KLA defenses.  Be careful up there, because your plane will 
respond a little slower due to the thinner air.
  You can see this mission suspended in the air from your airstrip. 
Take off from runway and take this garbage out.
------------------------------------------------------------------------






 Mission Code Name : Killer Party
 Direction         : North North West
 Distance          : 17 miles  
 Difficulty        : 5
Sxyth 1072110 303120 90845 0
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Some aliens are having a gathering at a site North of here.  The word
from intelligence is that it is a celebration ceremony in honor of
the historical firestorming of New Orleans on Earth.  Your orders are to 
toast every last one of the monsters with extreme prejudice.
  There is an airstrip handily nearby to land on, so this should be a
relatively easy mission.  However, be careful, we've already lost two
pilots at this site.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------- Welcome to Crickety Point Landing Strip ----------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : Overzealous Hostess
 Direction         : North North West
 Distance          : 21 miles  
 Difficulty        : 4
Sxyth 5946293 232621 152395 6356
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  A heavy concentration of KLA's has been noted to the North of here.
Go take care of the missiles, and pick up any fuel dumps as a bonus.
------------------------------------------------------------------------






 Mission Code Name : 3WD
 Direction         : North East
 Distance          : 13 miles  
 Difficulty        : 3
Sxyth 4207607 -1610425 92070 63888
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Go Northeast of here, and take out those pesky three wheeled vehicles.
They are wreaking havoc on our ground operations in the area.  Use extra
caution, since there seems to be something unusual about that orb.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------ Welcome to Sweetly Bending Oak Aircraft Park --------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------





Available Missions:


 Mission Code Name : Esso
 Direction         : South South West
 Distance          : 8 miles  
 Difficulty        : 2
Sxyth -5471735 4243871 159298 31320
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  To the South is a small oil facility.  Some lackluster AAA is guarding
it.  Your mission is to remove it from the map.
------------------------------------------------------------------------





 Mission Code Name : Vauxhall
 Direction         : West
 Distance          : 14 miles  
 Difficulty        : 3
Sxyth -4466299 6002717 171615 19166
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Go west and destroy four saucer sites.  Watch out for some nasty
KLA's.
------------------------------------------------------------------------





 Mission Code Name : Beware Of Dog
 Direction         : East
 Distance          : 14 miles  
 Difficulty        : 2
Sxyth -4732296 2969673 107728 49570
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  An orb with passive defenses lies 14 miles east of here.  Zip out
there and take it out.  This should be a real milkrun.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

               Nearby airstrips with more missions

------------------------------------------------------------------------
North: Easter Island Municipal Air Travel Center
East:  Weedsport Airport
------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------- Welcome to Easter Island Municipal Air Travel Center ----------
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : Early Bird
 Direction         : West
 Distance          : 1 miles  
 Difficulty        : 2
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  To our embarrassment, a saucer site has sprung up right next to our
airfield during the night.  Take it out either on foot or from the air.
------------------------------------------------------------------------





 Mission Code Name : Keystone Cops
 Direction         : East
 Distance          : 13 miles  
 Difficulty        : 3
Sxyth -905237 3058394 136168 56916
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  A gathering of ground forces has been sighted to the East.  Go out 
there, and rip up the mobile vehicles and their sites.  Some KLA
activity has been reported, but our recon photos show no sites present.
------------------------------------------------------------------------





 Mission Code Name : Cliff Hanger
 Direction         : North West
 Distance          : 18 miles  
 Difficulty        : 3
Sxyth 1576711 4799507 75191 15690
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Three forcefield hangers enclose three saucer aircraft.  Approach with
caution;  Not all the AAA at this stronghold are of low quality.  Your
mission is to remove the saucer threat.
------------------------------------------------------------------------



               Nearby airstrips with more missions

------------------------------------------------------------------------
North:  Valmart Airstrip and Family Value Center
East:   RDU ^international Airport
South:  Easter Island Municipal Air Travel Center
------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------- Valmart Airstrip and Family Value Center ----------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : Bumble Domino
 Direction         : North North East
 Distance          : 13 miles  
 Difficulty        : 3
Sxyth 3834802 40545570 228959 0
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  There is a lonely orb way up to the northeast of our position.  Go
blow it out of the sky.  There are a couple of AAA, but they don't
look too threatening.
------------------------------------------------------------------------




 Mission Code Name : Running Man
 Direction         : North West
 Distance          : 21 miles  
 Difficulty        : 3
Sxyth 5137596 6011711 106672 17448
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  A well protected orb is inverted, and we think it can be destroyed
with an assassin bomb.  A bombed out runway is available to land on,
but don't let your plane fall into a crater.
  Your secondary target is a saucer parked in a nest of mortars to 
the Northwest of the primary.
------------------------------------------------------------------------






 Mission Code Name : None
 Direction         : Maybe to the east
 Distance          : Unknown
 Difficulty        : 3
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  There have been unconfirmed reports of a saucer somewhere to the west.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
